correctness.rationale: Primal-dual independence exactly characterizes all fixed shattered coordinate sets by basis deletion/extension. A path specified by a ground-set partition in any adaptive shattered tree yields at most the sum of primal and dual subset ranks. Edmonds intersection min-max equates upper and lower bounds. A fixed-sign predictor with caching attains the same worst-case realizable mistake bound. Direct independent enumeration of all 498 labeled matroids through five elements and K3/K4/K5 agrees with all four displayed invariants; the proof, not enumeration, establishes all sizes.

value.rationale: Exact equality of two generally different learning dimensions for the entire natural class of matroid bases, computable in polynomial time via matroid intersection, with an especially simple optimal fixed-prediction online algorithm and a direct graphic spanning-tree structural invariant. This gives a motivated cross-domain classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice or routine numerical extension.
